t.zh: 有了<part-ref to="sampleGrid"></part-ref>，每个新像素都知道自己落在原图的哪里；可这个位置一般不是整数，原图在那里没有像素。
t.en: With the <part-ref to="sampleGrid"></part-ref> every new pixel knows where it sits in the original; but that position is seldom a whole number, and the original has no pixel there.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：落在两个旧像素之间的新像素，最简单的取值办法是什么？新元件<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>按整数坐标在图上取值，<part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref>读出图的宽高，<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>把一个数向下取整。离两边一样远时，约定取坐标较大的一边。输出图逐格和期望相符才算对。
t.en: This level asks: what is the simplest value for a new pixel between two old ones? New parts: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads an image at whole-number coordinates, <part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref> gives an image's width and height, and <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds a number down. When a position is equally far from two pixels, the convention takes the larger coordinate. It is right when the output matches the expected image cell by cell.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour"></wiki-ref>：每个新像素照抄离它最近的旧像素。快、边缘硬，放大后成块，新图里只有原图已有的值。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour"></wiki-ref>: each new pixel copies the nearest old one. Fast and hard-edged, blocky when enlarged, with no value the original did not already have.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，每个新像素照抄原图里离它最近的那个像素。
brief.en: Given an image and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel copying the original pixel nearest to it.

hint.zh: 取像素只接受整数坐标，也不接受原图外面的坐标。
hint.en: The lookup takes only whole-number coordinates, and none outside the image.

hint.zh: 离一个坐标最近的整数，和它向下取整得到的整数，什么时候不一样？
hint.en: When does the whole number nearest a coordinate differ from the one rounding down gives?
